title: Tag Propagation Settings
description: Controls whether tags applied to a service, database or schema flow down to the assets beneath them. Off by default: turning it on changes which tags every affected asset reports, and therefore what existing tag-based policies match.

enabled.description: Propagate tags from a parent down to its assets. Propagated labels are reported as `Derived`, so they are read-only on the asset and disappear when the parent's tag is removed.
